relations.rationale: Pairing rotation rules are unrelated to the ages of Xavi and Mina.
Pairing rotation to avoid repeat matchups is unrelated to which houses Mina and Jude belong to.
Rotating pairings does not bear on whether players later compared standings on a chalkboard.
Being close in age supports the more specific claim that both were a year older than Fay.
Xavi and Mina being close in age doesn't directly establish Fay's status as youngest at the table.
If Xavi and Mina were both a year older than Fay, Fay is younger than at least these two, supporting the claim she was youngest overall.
Fay being the youngest at the table has no bearing on which houses Mina and Jude belong to.
Mina and Jude being in different houses supports the existence of at least two houses, consistent with there being exactly two.
Comparing standings near the end of the session is a separate activity from cleaning up afterward, though both occur near the session's end.
